teaser.en: A ball of scarlet flowers on a single stem, and a name that warns it is as dangerous as a snake.
teaser.sw: Mpira wa maua mekundu kama damu juu ya shina moja, na jina linaloonya kuwa ni hatari kama nyoka.
teaser.dg: Chitswa cha maruwa ga kundu dzulu ya mlita mmwenga, na dzina rinaloonya kukala ni wa hatari dza nyoka.

summary.en: Mnazi wa nyoka is the blood lily, a bulb plant with a striking red ball of flowers. Its name, 'snake's coconut tree', is a warning that the plant is poisonous.
summary.sw: Mnazi wa nyoka ni *blood lily*, mmea wa kitunguu-mzizi (tunguu) wenye mpira wa maua mekundu unaovutia macho. Jina lake, 'mnazi wa nyoka', ni onyo kwamba mmea huu una sumu.
summary.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* ni *blood lily*, mmea wa chiazi wenye chitswa cha maruwa ga kundu chinachoonekana sana. Dzinare, 'mnazi wa nyoka', rinaonya kukala mmea uhu ni wa sumu.

about.en: *Mnazi wa nyoka* is a bulb plant. Before or with the rains it puts up a single fleshy stalk topped by a round head of many red flowers, often as wide as a hand or wider, with long stamens that give it the look of a fireball. The leaves are broad, with wavy edges, and they grow on a false stem that is often spotted with purple at the base, like a small palm trunk. The flowers are followed by small red berries.
about.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* ni mmea unaoota kutoka kwenye tunguu (kitunguu-mzizi). Kabla ya mvua au pamoja nazo, hutoa kikonyo kimoja chenye nyama, ambacho juu yake kuna kichwa cha mviringo cha maua mengi mekundu, mara nyingi chenye upana wa kiganja au zaidi, na stameni ndefu zinazokipa sura ya mpira wa moto. Majani ni mapana, yenye kingo za mawimbi, na huota juu ya shina bandia ambalo mara nyingi lina madoa ya zambarau chini, kama shina dogo la mnazi. Baada ya maua huja beri ndogo nyekundu.
about.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* ni mmea wa chiazi. Kabla ya mvula au phamwenga na mvula unalavya mlita mmwenga wenye madzi manji, na dzuluye kuna chitswa cha mviringo cha maruwa manji ga kundu, mara nyinji upanawe ni sawa na mkpwono au zaidi, na stameni ndire zinazouhenda uonekane dza mpira wa moho. Makodzage ni mapana, ga kanda-kanda zenye maimbi, na ganamera dzulu ya kolo ra handzo ambaro mara nyinji rina madowa ga zambarau photsi, dza kolo ridide ra muhi wa jamii ya mnazi. Maruwa gachimala kunamera matunda madide ga kundu.

where.en: It grows in shady forest, thicket and bushland, and comes up with the rains. The species is widespread in tropical and southern Africa.
where.sw: Unaota kivulini msituni, katika vichaka vizito na vichaka, na huchipuka mvua zinaponyesha. Spishi hii imeenea sana katika Afrika ya kitropiki na kusini mwa Afrika.
where.dg: Unamera tsakani phatu phenye chivuri-vuri, vitsakani na weruni, na unamera mvula ichinya. Aina ihi inaphahikana phatu phanji kpwenye tsi za dzoho za Afrika na kusini ya Afrika.

uses.en: The bulb is poisonous, as Digo speakers recognise in the name.
uses.sw: Tunguu lake lina sumu, kama Wadigo wanavyotambua katika jina lake.
uses.dg: Chiaziche ni cha sumu, dza Adigo anavyomanya na kuonyesa kpwenye dzinare.

culture.en: Pakia uses this name as an example of animal names that act as warnings in plant naming. The snake (*nyoka*) signals that the plant is poisonous.
culture.sw: Pakia analitumia jina hili kama mfano wa majina ya wanyama yanayotumika kama maonyo katika kuipa mimea majina. Nyoka (*nyoka*) huashiria kwamba mmea una sumu.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga nyama ganayohumirwa kuonya kpwenye kuiha mimea. Nyoka (*nyoka*) inaonyesa kukala mmea uhu ni wa sumu.

names.en: *Mnazi wa nyoka* means 'coconut tree of the snake'. It grows like a small coconut palm (*mnazi*), and the snake signals that it is poisonous. Pakia stresses that it is not related to the coconut, despite the name. The same name is used for *Siphonochilus brachystemon*, a forest ginger. 'Blood lily' is a common English name for the species, but it is not given by Pakia.
names.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* maana yake ni 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Unakua kama mnazi mdogo (*mnazi*), na nyoka huashiria kwamba una sumu. Pakia anasisitiza kwamba hauna uhusiano na mnazi, licha ya jina lake. Jina hilo hilo hutumika kwa *Siphonochilus brachystemon*, mmea wa msituni wa jamii ya tangawizi. Kwa Kiingereza spishi hii huitwa kwa kawaida *blood lily*, lakini Pakia hatoi jina hilo.
names.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* rina mana ya 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Unamera dza mnazi mdide (*mnazi*), na nyoka inaonyesa kukala ni wa sumu. Pakia anagomba kpwa nguvu kukala mmea uhu tauhusiana na mnazi, hata dzinare richikala vivyo. Dzina hiri piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Siphonochilus brachystemon*, tangawizi ya tsakani. *Blood lily* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinalohumirwa sana kpwa aina ihi, ela Pakia kariandika.

reason.dg: Una dzina mwenga ra Chidigo na mmea uhu

reason.en: The coconut palm its name refers to

reason.sw: Nao umepewa jina kama onyo ('muua kuku')

reason.sw: Flame lily, mmea mwingine wa tunguu wenye maua na sumu
reason.dg: *Flame lily*, mmea wanjina wa chiazi wa sumu wenye maruwa
